name: add-to-cart-button
title: Add To Cart Button
description: A button is pressed and squashes; a shirt pops out of its top, drops into a cart icon that ticks and drives off to the right while the label returns, with morphing shapes and an elastic settle.
useWhen: An online-shop promo needs the add-to-cart moment shown as a satisfying micro-interaction.
A product or app UI demo needs a button that confirms an action.
avoidWhen: You need a full checkout flow: use checkout-flow.
The product is not clothing and the shirt would confuse: pick a plainer cart icon such as icon-shopping-cart.
author: aaroniker

variables.label: Tick color
variables.description: Colour of the check mark in the cart.
